calculator_engine:
function xirr(cashFlows,dates){// Newton-Raphson iteration
let r=0.1;for(let i=0;i<100;i++){let f=0,df=0;for(let j=0;j<cashFlows.length;j++){const t=(dates[j]-dates[0])/(365*24*3600*1000);f+=cashFlows[j]/Math.pow(1+r,t);df+=-t*cashFlows[j]/Math.pow(1+r,t+1);}const nr=r-f/df;if(Math.abs(nr-r)<1e-7)return{xirr:(nr*100).toFixed(2)};r=nr;}return{xirr:(r*100).toFixed(2)};}
